name: Mississippi

agency.name: Mississippi State Oil and Gas Board

form.name: Application for Permit to Drill, Workover, Unit Reformation, Conversion or Change of Operator
form.notes: Read both pages. One form covers new drills and re-entries, workovers (recompletion, dual, commingle, horizontal deviation), unit reformation, conversion and change of operator. Fee $600 to drill, convert, or workover to dual or horizontal; $100 to recomplete another zone or change operator; proof of financial responsibility; certified plat; for new drills a reserve pit diagram, mud disposal statement and surface casing and cementing program. Latitude and longitude (NAD83, five decimals) for surface and bottom hole. Permit lapses after 12 months (6 for recompletions) if work not begun. Submitter e-mail, address and phone are on the form but not published as data.

api_number.n: API14 and API10 (well list); API (shapefile); form has an API No. box (assigned or existing)

permit_number.n: 'Permit #' column in the Permit Search report; also printed in Permit Activity PDFs; not in bulk files

lease_name.n: Form 2 has well name and number, field and reservoir, but no lease or unit name box

operator_id.n: Form 2 asks the company name only, no operator number; registration Form 1 not read

operator_type.n: No business-type box on Form 2; registration Form 1 not read

bond.n: Proof of financial responsibility must accompany the Form 2 (Rules 4 and 63)

county.n: County (well list); CountyName (shapefile); county box on form

district.n: Only a 'field inspector information' box (office use); no district column in the data

field_pool.n: Field and PoolName (well list, pool filled on 12,090 of 35,218 wells); wildcat yes/no box on form

surface_latlon.n: Lat(NAD83), Long(NAD83) on 25,558 of 35,218 wells; form requires NAD83 decimal degrees

surface_plss.n: Sec, Twn, TwnDir, Rng, RngDir; form asks section, township, range and a location description

bottom_hole_loc.n: BH_Lat and BH_Long, only 598 of 35,218 wells; form asks BHL for directional or horizontal wells

lateral_path.n: Form asks only the bottom-hole point; no survey or path

elevation.n: Ground elevation (GR) box on Form 2; no elevation column in the files seen

surface_owner.n: Not asked; the ownership question on the form is about the drilling unit, not the surface

well_type.n: Type (OIL, GAS, SWD, EOR, DH, MON, ST...); form boxes Oil, Gas, SWD, EOR, Brine, Monitor, Storage, Strat Test

work_type.n: 'Permit Types' column in Permit Search (values not seen); form: drill/reentry, workover, conversion, etc.

proposed_depth_md.n: 'Permit Depth' in Permit Search and Permit Activity PDFs; form asks proposed or actual MD; well list MD is as drilled?

proposed_depth_tvd.n: TVD box (proposed or actual); well list TotalVerticalDepth_TVD filled on only 528 wells, meaning not labeled

target_formation.n: PoolName (pool, not necessarily the target); form asks field and reservoir

casing_program.n: Proposed surface casing and cementing program attached (new drills); length of surface casing box

cement_program.n: Cementing program attached with the casing program (new drills)

pressure_control.n: No BOP item on Form 2 or its instructions

pit_waste.n: Reserve pit diagram and statement of mud disposal method attached (new drills)

fracture_plan.n: Not asked on Form 2 (a link to a chemical disclosure registry is on the home page)

spacing_unit.n: Acres ('SIZE') in Permit Activity PDFs; form has drilling-unit acres, distance to unit line, docket and order boxes

spacing_exception.n: Instructions: exceptions to statewide rules need a petition to the Board; docket and order number boxes

mineral_owner.n: Yes/no statement on separately owned tracts and agreement to develop (state code 53-3-7); no owner names

fee.n: $600 to drill, convert or workover to dual or horizontal; $100 recomplete or change operator

notice_hearing.n: Docket and order boxes when a Board petition is needed; no notice step on the form

date_received.n: Date box next to the submitter; not in the bulk files

date_approved.n: Shapefile PermitDate (name only; meaning not labeled); Permit Search shows 'Date Approved'

date_expires.n: No date box; instructions say it lapses after 12 months (6 for recompletions) if work not begun

spud_date.n: Form gives only the approximate start date; Well Date List has an 'Event' filter whose options were not seen

completion_date.n: Completion is on Form 3; Well Date List 'Event' options were not seen

status.n: Status and Active (well list); status description in shapefile; includes expired and cancelled permits

plat_image.n: Certified plat to scale attached; not seen online

form_image.n: Permit Activity PDFs are lists, not the form; online document access not checked

completion_report.n: Form 3 is the completion report per Form 2 text; online access not checked

logs.n: Home page menu shows 'Scout Card & Log Search'; not opened

production_link.n: Downloads page lists a daily production CSV (16.6 MB); columns not read

sources.name: Well shape files with additional fields (wells_otherfields, ESRI shapefile in a zip, daily)
activity_types: permit to drill, by current well type (oil, gas, dry hole, injection, brine disposal, gas storage, monitor...)
sources.tested: One GET of the 2026-10-31 zip: HTTP 200, 1.4 MB, holds .dbf, .shp, .shx, .prj. DBF has 25,281 records and 13 attributes; PermitDate is a date field (earliest 1905-11-01, six records are 00000000, newest 2026-10-21). Permit dates per year: 2023 48, 2024 22, 2025 29, 2026 18 (to Oct 21), against the Board's own annual totals of 37 for 2025 and 20 for 2026 through August, so the two do not match. The file names carry the day and the listing page keeps about a week of them. A sister zip (Wells.zip, spots and APIs only) was not downloaded.

grade_reason: A free daily shapefile reachable from here has one row per well with a PermitDate back to 1905, and a Permit Search report has Date Approved, permit type and depth, so monthly counts are possible. Held to B because the shapefile has no work type and its counts do not match the Board's own annual totals (29 against 37 for 2025), the meaning of PermitDate is not labeled, and the report that does have permit type is a script-driven page with no stable machine interface. Volume is tiny (about 20 to 60 permits a year).
producer_plan: Read the Downloads listing page to find the newest dated wells_otherfields zip (names change daily; one a day is kept for about a week). Unzip into its own folder, read the dBASE file with the standard library (record length 1,025; PermitDate is YYYYMMDD, 00000000 means missing), and count rows by month of PermitDate, dropping future or zero dates. Split by the type code: OIL and GAS as new drill, SWD, EOR and BDW as injection or disposal, GSR, GSC and MON as storage or monitor, ST and CORE as test wells; note the type is the well's current type, so a recent permit later logged as a dry hole (DH) changes band, and months must be recounted each run. Cross-check each year against the annual Permits to Drill PDF (county by month counts, 1987 onward, text extractable) and keep that PDF as the fallback series. Re-entries, workovers, conversions and operator changes are not separate in the bulk files: they would need the Permit Search report (permit type column), which the page builds by script, so test it by hand before relying on it. Expect only a handful of permits a month.
privacy_notes: The well list and shapefile name company operators only (no phone, e-mail or street address columns); an operator could still be an individual's trade name, so apply the tracker's nameable-operator rule. The Permit Activity PDFs carry a contractor field (N/A in the sample read). The blank form asks for a submitter's e-mail, address and phone, but these are not in the open data.
